title: malpighia fallax
intro: Malpighia fallax, commonly known as the Jamaican cherry or Panama berry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malpighiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Malpighia fallax include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
